mapper.insert: INSERT INTO short_drama_connection (provider_id, connection_name, base_url, partner_id, api_key_ciphertext, currency, filing_mode, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{providerId}, #{connectionName}, #{baseUrl}, #{partnerId}, #{apiKeyCiphertext}, #{currency}, COALESCE(#{filingMode}, 'API'), #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE short_drama_connection SET filing_mode = #{filingMode}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{connectionId}
